product: ERA5-Land monthly averaged data from 1950 to present: monthly_averaged_reanalysis 2024 (t2m, d2m, tp, e, ssrd, u10, v10, swvl1)
version: as served by the CDS (see file history attribute)
attribution: Muñoz Sabater, J. (2019): ERA5-Land monthly averaged data from 1950 to present. Copernicus Climate Change Service (C3S) Climate Data Store (CDS). DOI: 10.24381/cds.68d2bb30. Contains modified Copernicus Climate Change Service information 2024.
method: Each res-6 cell whose centre lies in the region box takes the value of the grid pixel containing its centre (nearest-pixel sampling, as for the NASA POWER layers); neighbouring cells repeat values. Monthly means of 2024; accumulated fields (tp, e, ssrd) are ERA5-Land's mean daily accumulation for the month. Evaporation sign flipped so evaporation is positive. ERA5-Land is land-only, so sea cells are absent.
sampling: nearest grid pixel at each cell centre
